charge.refuse.unsigned: This app is not signed, so there is no verified author to pay. Unsigned apps cannot take payments.
charge.refuse.tampered: This app has been changed since it was signed. Its payee cannot be trusted, so it cannot take payments.
charge.refuse.tamperedDetail: This app has been changed since it was signed ({detail}). Its payee cannot be trusted, so it cannot take payments.
charge.refuse.unverified: This app’s signature could not be verified, so it cannot take payments.
charge.refuse.keyChanged: The signing key published by {id} has changed since this computer last saw it. Payments are refused until that is resolved.
charge.error.noPrice: this app’s signed manifest sets no price for "{sku}" (manifest.pay.prices), so it cannot be sold
charge.error.wrongPrice: "{sku}" costs {price} in this app’s signed manifest, not {amount}
charge.error.noPayee: this app declares no payee (manifest.pay), so it cannot be paid
charge.error.noCeiling: no spending ceiling is set for this app — nothing may be charged
charge.error.overCeiling: this app asked for {amount} but its ceiling is {ceiling}
charge.paidBy.mpp: by card, through an AI agent (Stripe Link)
charge.receipt.title: GifOS Receipt
charge.receipt.proof: This file IS the proof: it carries a receipt signed by gifos.app, and opening it on any GifOS computer verifies the signature and registers the purchase there. Sharing it shares your license — the app treats whoever holds this receipt as the same buyer (same saves, same identity). Keep it with your backups.
